title: Case Mgr, MLOA [S], Disability and Leave Services
descriptionHtml:
This is a contractual role
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one.
We are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you’d like to help the Disability Leave Services (DLS) team build a best-in-class professional services program to deliver leave of absence, disability and accommodation services to Amazon employees, applicants, job seekers and candidates globally, this is your chance to make history by joining the amazing Disability & Leave Services Team.
The DLS Case Manager provides case management for all types of leave of absence and disability life events. The DLS Case Manager is highly skilled in answering questions, understanding the employee’s situation, applying the appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances and needs, and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. Case Managers are the single point of contact for an employee throughout an entire leave of absence or disability event.
This is an individual contribution (IC) role with no direct reports.
Essential Responsibilities:
• Initiate and respond to inquiries about leave and disability events, benefits, and options available to employees
• Serve as a point of contact for assigned employees to provide holistic case management services, including reviewing medical documentation to adjudicate leaves in compliance with the corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon
• Leverage duration guidelines, best practice tools and Amazon resources to support oversight of a leave event as appropriate
• Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs
• Address and respond to sensitive situations
• Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event
• Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication occurs
• Identify and solve problems that may arise, sometimes with limited information
• Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace
• Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to being off or returning back to work
• Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
• Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy
• Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
• Consult, coordinate and partner with our third party administrator, HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members and other departments/systems as appropriate
• Other duties as assigned

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- 1+ years of customer service experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- Experience with end-to-end ownership of major project deliverables
- Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
- Basic US legislation Leave of Absence, Disability and/or Accommodations knowledge, specifically ADA/ADAAA and FMLA
- Prior Leave and/or Accommodations experience, to include: previous work in a leave of absence and/or disability claim management role, with experience using case management systems, reviewing cases for eligibility, determining the appropriate leave and/or disability pay benefits that apply to a specific situation, and establishing/executing a case management plan.

title: Sr. Risk Mgr, Intake Litigation SME, Amazon Flex, Service Level Standards
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Flex works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With Amazon Flex, individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. Amazon Flex is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on-board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more.

Amazon Flex's Service Level Standards (SLS) team is seeking a Litigation Risk Manager to join our Critical Operations function. Our team ensures that enforcement actions taken against delivery partners are fair, defensible, and well-documented — and when those decisions are contested through legal channels, we investigate thoroughly.

As a Litigation Risk Manager, you will play a crucial role in managing legal disputes arising from delivery partner enforcement actions. You'll be responsible for conducting in-depth investigations into contested offboarding decisions, developing disposition recommendations for legal proceedings, and serving as a subject matter witness when required. This role offers the opportunity to work with cross-functional teams - including legal, outside counsel, enforcement program owners, and regulatory stakeholders - while directly contributing to the protection and compliance of Amazon's last-mile delivery operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct end-to-end deep-dive investigations into contested delivery partner enforcement actions, determining whether offboarding decisions adhered to established policies and procedures
- Develop and deliver well-reasoned disposition recommendations for active litigation and arbitration matters
- Serve as a subject matter witness in arbitration hearings, tribunal proceedings, and regulatory inquiries - articulating the company's enforcement rationale clearly and accurately
- Partner closely with internal legal teams and outside counsel to align on case strategy, timelines, and desired outcomes
- Monitor and manage caseload with competing priorities, jurisdictional deadlines, and strict SLAs
- Identify emerging litigation trends, recurring claim patterns, and systemic risks across jurisdictions
- Provide closed-loop feedback to enforcement program owners to proactively address root causes of disputes
- Identify opportunities for workflow efficiency improvements and contribute to process optimization
- Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure responses are accurate, comprehensive, and delivered on time

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

title: Mechatronic Apprentice I
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

• You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all material handling equipment components.

• You will maintain and troubleshoot motors, photo eyes, relays, proximity sensors, solenoids, motor starters, tachs, etc.
• You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Program Requirements:
• Flexible to relocate after completion of the program

• Able to enroll in and attend a 9-week training at one of four designated training providers (Location to be determined post-interview)

• Meet the minimum qualifying score on a Mechanical Aptitude Test

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High School Diploma
- 1+ years of PC software experience including Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook experience
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 1+ years of Amazon RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) experience
- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience measurement reading and interpretation
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of military experience
- Experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
- Experience troubleshooting and diagnosing material handling equipment (MHE)

title: Sr. Communication Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Come work at Amazon!

The Role:
Be part of the team defining the overall communication system and architecture of Leo’s broadband wireless network. This is a unique opportunity to innovate and define groundbreaking wireless technology with few legacy constraints. The team develops and designs the communication system of Leo and analyzes its overall system level performance such as for overall throughput, latency, system availability, packet loss etc.

This role in particular will be responsible for leading the effort in integration, verification and testing of the systems especially focused on MAC and higher layer testing. This role will also be responsible developing and testing advanced L1/L2/L3 concept to improve the performance and reliability of the LEO network. This role will also be part of a team and develop simulation tools with particular emphasis on modeling the physical layer aspects such as advanced receiver modeling and abstraction, interference cancellation techniques, FEC abstraction models etc.

In this role you will:
- Work within a project team and take the responsibility for the Leo’s communication system design, system integration and verification.
- Work as a part of the team in building a suite of system and network simulation services in Matlab / C++ / Python
- Develop requirements from system level to HW/SW level and define test cases associated with the requirements.
- Identify additional HW and SW that are needed for the purposes of verification and guide the HW/SW development team in the development of these test solutions/tools//
- Work closely with implementation teams to simulate expected system level performance and provide quick feedback on potential improvements
- Write scripts / code for functions / features required for specific simulation, testing and verification of given RF system

EXPORT CONTROL REQUIREMENTS

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- 7+ years of experience in wireless systems design and / or RF design implementation
- Experience in wireless system design and architecture, system integration, RF system analysis
- 7+ years of experience developing code in Matlab, C, C++, or Python, and experience with industry standard coding and regression practices

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with information theory and network coding
- Experience with mobile mesh networks
- Experience in modeling and performance analysis of LEO Satellite Networks
- Experience with simulation of RF standards like (4G/5G), 802.11, DVB-S2 / DVB-C, OR similar broadband wireless standards
- Wireless Communications System design and development with emphasis on L1 and L2.
- System level and link level simulation of wireless networks.
- Capacity, performance and interference analysis of wireless networks.
- Development of advanced physical layer and MAC layer techniques for wireless networks.
- Design and understanding of advanced information theory and network coding concepts.
- Design and development physical layer and some MAC layer techniques for high spectral efficiency.
- Excellent analytical, problem solving, and communication skills

title: Systems Development Engineer, Managed Edge Compute (Amazon Robotics)
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join the Unified Workcell Compute team. This is a hands-on role where you will help design and build systems that manage Amazon's edge device fleet, over a million devices across thousands of locations worldwide. You will work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, device management, robotics systems, and operational excellence, delivering well-scoped technical solutions that help Amazon's robotics and fulfillment operations run reliably and scale.

As a SysDE engineer early in your systems development journey, you will be a strong individual contributor who takes well-understood problems and feature specifications and delivers working, well-tested systems, software, and tooling that meet the Amazon Code Bar. You will solve straightforward problems using smaller or stand-alone components, participate in your team's design, scoping, and prioritization discussions, and learn how the team makes decisions in the context of business goals and customer needs. You will get your designs, code, and procedures reviewed, incorporate feedback, and rarely repeat the same mistake. You will take ownership of the systems you inherit and the ones you build, apply the principles of operational excellence, troubleshoot failures even in systems you did not author, and escalate blockers early. The role builds working knowledge across Linux systems, AWS services, IoT platforms, robotics compute infrastructure, and distributed systems, along with the ability to partner effectively with engineers on your team.

Key job responsibilities

- Build and maintain resilient, scalable distributed systems that operate at Amazon scale, contributing to the management of robotics device fleets across thousands of sites with 99.99%+ availability requirements.
- Contribute to the technical strategy for your team's systems within the UWC architecture, participating in decisions around hyperscale deployments, robotics compute patterns, fleet management, and edge device automation.
- Participate in architectural reviews and design discussions across UWC and robotics customer teams, contributing technical input on device lifecycle management, software distribution, multi-compute workcell assistance, and operational excellence patterns.
- Develop automation solutions using Python, Rust, CDK, and AWS services that eliminate entire classes of operational load and enable self-service for robotics solution teams.
- Implement and optimize Linux-based systems, OS image creation pipelines (Yocto/mkosi), and BSP solutions for diverse robotics hardware platforms including x86, ARM, NVIDIA GPU systems, and embedded devices.
- Create tooling and frameworks that enable robotics teams to provision, configure, and manage their edge compute fleets — from AI perception systems to manipulation robotics — with minimal hands-on-keyboard time.
- Apply established standards for engineering, testing, and operational excellence best practices, and suggest improvements to processes within your team.
- Identify and implement opportunities to streamline or eliminate excess processes, improving agility and reducing complexity for robotics teams building on UWC.
- Proactively identify and escalate risks at the product and service level, contributing to the resilience, performance, and cost efficiency of UWC systems aiding critical robotics operations.
- Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack — from robotics device hardware and Linux kernel to AWS cloud services — identifying patterns and implementing solutions that prevent future incidents.
- Partner with robotics solution teams (Amazon Robotics, manipulation systems, AI perception, workcell automation) to translate their device management challenges and contribute to solutions that meet their specific requirements.
- Foster the growth of peers on your team through code reviews, knowledge exchange, and collectively problem-solving that raises the technical bar.
- Deliver solutions that are inventive, resilient, and extensible, making it easier for robotics teams to build on UWC.
- Participate in hiring and contribute to technical assessm

A day in the life
Your day might start by investigating an issue where robotics devices across multiple fulfillment centers are experiencing intermittent kernel panics during high-load operations. You dive deep into kernel logs, memory dumps, and device telemetry, correlating the failures with a recent driver update for NVIDIA GPU systems. You develop a Python or Rust-based diagnostic tool to capture more granular system metrics and partner with senior engineers to roll back the problematic driver version while working on a fix that addresses the underlying memory management issue.

Mid-morning, you're troubleshooting why a new OS image isn't booting correctly on ARM-based manipulation robotics devices. You boot into a recovery environment, examine the initramfs, trace through systemd unit reliances, and discover a race condition in the device initialization sequence. You modify the Yocto recipe to fix the boot ordering, test across multiple hardware variants, and document the pattern for other teams building custom images. You then join a sync with an Amazon Robotics team to help them debug why their software components are failing to deploy — walking through IoT certificate validation, network linkage from the edge device, and AWS IAM permissions until you identify a misconfigured security group.

After lunch, you're participating in a code review for a new credential rotation service — providing written feedback on error handling patterns, memory safety, and how to better structure the state machine for resilience. You spend time optimizing a Linux system configuration that's causing performance bottlenecks on AI perception systems — configuring and tuning Linux system parameters to enable high-performance compute workloads. You pair with a teammate who's working through a complex Yocto build failure, exchanging what you know about layer reliances and BitBake recipe inheritance while partnering on debugging techniques.

The afternoon includes answering to a page where devices in a specific building can't link to AWS IoT Core. You systematically eliminate possibilities — checking DNS resolution, testing TLS handshakes, examining certificate chains, and analyzing network packet captures — until you discover a misconfigured firewall rule blocking MQTT traffic. You implement a monitoring enhancement to detect this class of issue proactively across all sites. You then contribute to a technical design document proposing improvements to UWC's device provisioning workflow that will reduce provisioning time from 20 minutes to under 10 minutes by parallelizing certificate generation and optimizing the Linux boot sequence. You'll end your day reviewing system metrics across the fleet, flagging devices with degraded disk I/O that need proactive maintenance, and syncing with your team on priorities for tomorrow.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, Prime Video Partner Experience & Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you'll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You'll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You'll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We'll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

What You'll Do

Join Prime Video's Partner Experience & Supply Chain team as a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer and become the technical leader who defines how we turn partner and supply chain data into business intelligence at scale. You will be the recognized data authority for the organization, owning the long-term view of our BI architecture and how it fits together across systems, and setting the standard for how insights are produced, trusted, and acted upon.

You'll operate in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, working with limited guidance alongside product managers, engineers, and operations leaders. You will not just build dashboards, you will shape the analytics strategy for the org, decide where to invest, and lead large initiatives that require the coordinated work of multiple data professionals.

The Problems You'll Solve

Our supply chain generates massive amounts of data, but data alone doesn't drive change, insights do. You'll take on the intrinsically hard, undefined problems: Where are the systemic bottlenecks slowing content delivery, and what is the root cause across the pipeline rather than the symptom? Which partner workflows need to be re-architected? How do we predict and prevent supply chain issues before they impact customers?

You will own the data lineage end to end, developing deep understanding of and influence over the technical systems that generate the data, how metrics are aggregated, and how the resulting business intelligence is consumed, interpreted, and acted upon by the business. When problems are pervasive or persistent, you drive them to root cause, and your fixes may unblock related teams across the organization.

What Makes This Role Different

You'll be a strategic partner and a key influencer in team strategy, shaping how Prime Video manages relationships with content partners and optimizes the entire supply chain. You will anticipate, and where appropriate influence, stakeholders' future requirements rather than react to them. You will show good judgment making trade-offs between team investment (prioritization, data retention policy, infrastructure cost) and business need, and you will only advocate for new BI solutions when they are genuinely necessary.

Your work directly influences how quickly and efficiently we bring content to millions of viewers worldwide, and you will ensure the team is stronger because of your presence but does not require your presence to succeed.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of BI solutions in complex and/or ambiguous problem areas, taking the long-term view of how each solution fits the team's architecture and lifecycle, and proactively fixing architecture deficiencies
Own and influence data lineage across the organization, from how data is generated through how metrics are aggregated to how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon
Lead large, multi-person BI projects: decompose them into parallel workstreams for yourself and other data professionals, and reassemble the work into a cohesive, successful launch
Drive BI engineering best practices and set standards for the org (operational excellence, code reviews, syntax and naming conventions, metric definitions, alarms); ensure solutions are accurate, timely, accessible, and actionable
Build inventive, robust, scalable, and extensible data pipelines, data models, and dashboards from multi-dimensional datasets that others can easily maintain and build upon
Resolve the root cause of pervasive or persistent problems, influencing decisions across teams and building consensus to find and drive the best path forward
Understand and articulate the capabilities and limitations of the systems you work with (e.g., cluster size, concurrent users, data classification) to both technical and non-technical audiences, clarifying what is possible today versus what requires technology investment
Build fast prototypes using Amazon AI tools (Kiro, Claude CLI, QuickSuite) and translate them into production-grade data products, selecting optimal tools by balancing speed, efficiency, and scalability
Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders verbally and in writing, and influence their decisions and future requirements

About the team
We are part of the central Product and Data Team within the Partner Experience & Supply Chain organization at Prime Video. Our structure and scope is a hybrid model where we collaborate closely with our tech teams to build data products that solve problems affecting PV customers and our internal stakeholders.

We optimize the supply chain and deliver the highest standard of video streaming content to our customers. Our team is the trusted analytical powerhouse that drives unified data solutions, making Prime Video the preferred entertainment destination for customers worldwide.

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
- 8+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
- 5+ years of SQL experience
- 4+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Prior experience with AWS services across data storage, querying, transformation, and visualization (QuickSight, Redshift, Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining
- Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.


Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

About the team
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
descriptionHtml:
Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
- Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
- Map and manage cross-team and cross-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
- Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
- Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
- Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
- Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
- Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.

- Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

descriptionHtml:

As an Operations Technology II engineer within the Facility Operations Center (FOC), you will remotely monitor data center power and cooling systems across the globe, acting as the first line of response when alarms fire. Your analysis and quick decision-making directly protect the availability of AWS Data Centers and the millions of customers who depend on them. If you enjoy working with complex mechanical and electrical systems in a fast-paced environment and want to grow your technical expertise, this role is for you.

The FOC operates on a follow-the-sun model, so your fixed daytime schedule supports 24/7 coverage without overnight shifts.

The Facility Operations Center is the command center for AWS Data Center operations, providing continuous global monitoring 24/7/365 through a follow-the-sun model. title: Data Center Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
G'day! You've found an opportunity that could define your next chapter.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

The Mission — Why This Programme, Why Now?
You're joining at the defining moment of one of the most significant technology programmes Australia has ever undertaken. This programme will build and operate the dedicated cloud giving Australia's national security community and its allies the capability to see more, share more, innovate and act faster than ever before.

The architectural decisions being made now — how we structure networking, implement security controls, and automate at scale — will shape how Australia's national security community operates for the next decade.

Your Role in the Story
Imagine being the person who keeps one of the world's largest and most critical information system infrastructures running at peak performance. As a Data Centre Technician, you'll be the hands-on expert who ensures the physical backbone of the cloud never misses a beat. Every server you deploy, every cable you run, every issue you troubleshoot directly enables Australia's national security community to operate with confidence.

This isn't just maintenance — it's mission-critical stewardship. You'll apply deep knowledge of computer architecture and the OSI model to solve complex, real-world problems that most engineers only read about. Your troubleshooting instincts will span server hardware, fibre optics, networking, and beyond. When something goes wrong at 2am, you'll be the calm, capable expert the team relies on.

You'll join an expanding Infrastructure Operations team where your growth trajectory is limited only by your ambition. The skills you build here — across hardware, networking, Linux systems, and large-scale operations — will make you one of the most versatile infrastructure professionals in the country.

- Health, income protection and life cover — Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.

- Amazon Extras & employee discount — cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Key job responsibilities


Building and Deploying
You'll install and configure racks to internal SLAs, plan and track capacity, and deploy cabling infrastructure that forms the nervous system of the cloud. Every rack you stand up expands Australia's sovereign capability.

Troubleshooting and Resolving
When trouble tickets land, you'll prioritise with precision and resolve with speed. You'll serve as the escalation point for all systems issues — the person teams turn to when problems get complex. Your Linux expertise will be your superpower as you deep dive into server-level challenges that others can't crack.

Leading Through Complexity
During high-severity incidents, you'll be the technical point of contact — coordinating response, communicating clearly, and driving resolution. You'll meet 24x7 on-call requirements during shift rotations, knowing that your vigilance directly protects national capability.

Physical Excellence
You'll work confidently with equipment up to 20 kg, navigate cramped spaces and elevated locations, and do it all within rigorous health and safety guidelines. This is infrastructure work at its most tangible and rewarding.

title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship
descriptionHtml:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.



About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Monday through Friday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. title: Principal PMT, Alexa Personality & EQ, Alexa Core Experience
descriptionHtml:
Alexa is Amazon's AI assistant, and customers have been talking to it for years. They already have a relationship with Alexa and an opinion about who Alexa is. The way Alexa talks, reacts, and connects is central to what makes it distinctive, and we are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the vision for that: who Alexa is, how it engages, and how it makes millions of customers feel understood in every interaction. You will decide what that character becomes next. The work you own shapes every customer conversation, on every device, in every context.

Role summary

Alexa is a distinct character, and that character is a core part of what makes Alexa valuable to customers. As the Principal PMT for Alexa Personality & EQ, you will define and protect it. You will own the multi-year vision for who Alexa is and how it expresses that identity across every customer interaction: its voice, tone, emotional intelligence, and humor. You will hold two goals in tension, making Alexa feel deeply personalized to each customer while remaining unmistakably and consistently itself.

This is a hands-in-the-product role, not a set-strategy-and-hand-off role. You'll author instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship those changes, and iterate week over week. The work demands real technical depth: you will work directly with frontier models, partner with design on how the character is expressed in the experience, and partner closely with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated, operating at the edge of what they can do today.

You will translate a subjective, high-judgment question, "who should Alexa be, and how should it feel to interact with Alexa," into a concrete and decomposed strategy that can be applied across Alexa, an explicit and measurable definition of Alexa's emotional intelligence, and shipped experiences. Building the mechanisms to measure that standard is as much of the job as defining it, through to the go/no-go calls on shipping model and prompt changes. These approaches are established and still evolving quickly, which means part of the work is inventing what comes next. Someone expecting pure creative strategy will be surprised by how much rigor this demands.

While you own the character strategy, there are many pieces across the technology stack that you will influence (not own), like the deeper technology that produces Alexa's voice and visual rendering. You co-own the quality bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction, and you are accountable for whether the shipped expression is true to Alexa's personality. You are also the steward of keeping Alexa, Alexa, catching updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would dilute the character.

Personality is one of the most subjective domains in product development. There is no ground truth and no dataset that tells you who Alexa should be. You will need to push innovative ideas through an organization, and have the backbone to defend a creative point of view when the data is ambiguous and the stakes are high. The right person finds that energizing, not exhausting. Because personality touches every response Alexa gives, this is a horizontal charter: you set the bar and drive many product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities
• Define who Alexa is. Own and evangelize the multi-year vision and strategy for Alexa's personality and emotional intelligence, expressed operationally: voice, tone, conversational style, and emotional range. Align leaders behind a single definition that holds across an extremely diverse and vast customer surface area.
• Author and ship the instructions that shape how Alexa behaves. Write the character instructions and style prompts that produce Alexa's personality, ship them, and iterate weekly. Partner with design on how the character comes through in the experience, and with science and engineering on how the models are tuned and evaluated.
• Define and measure the quality bar, and own the ship decisions. Turn subjective qualities like emotional intelligence into evaluable standards, and build the automated judges and annotation rubrics that measure them. Co-own the bar with design, who shapes how the character is expressed in interaction. Own the calls to ship or hold new model versions and prompt changes, and turn failure patterns in the data into instruction changes the same week.
• Own humor and wit as first-class craft. Calibrate joke quality, handle roasts and playful pushback, judge when wit lands, and know when not to be funny. Humor is one of the hardest attributes to get right and one of the most defining.
• Protect the character from dilution. Be the backstop that keeps Alexa recognizably Alexa, catching the updates, new features, and convergence pressure that would flatten what makes Alexa distinct. This means holding the bar against cross-team priorities.
• Own personalization and the customer-facing controls. Own the product strategy and roadmap for the controls that let people shape how Alexa engages with them, and define how the preferences a customer sets, along with the context of the conversation, shape Alexa's responses. Work with design to define the experience each should produce.
• Keep the character trustworthy. Partner with Responsible AI and Trust & Safety so Alexa's personality is appropriate in sensitive contexts and reinforces customer trust.
• Look ahead to new forms of expression. Work with design to anticipate the new ways Alexa's character will come through as the experience evolves, and hold the same quality bar wherever it shows up.
• Lead horizontally. As the single owner of the bar, drive product, science, design, and engineering teams to meet it without direct authority, and represent Alexa's character in executive-level planning.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience technical product management

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
- Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- MBA, or Master's degree
- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders
- Experience building evaluation systems for model quality (for example automated judges, human annotation rubrics, or A/B quality comparisons) and making ship or hold decisions through model migrations.
- Experience defining a product vision for something subjective, high-judgment, or brand-defining, and turning it into measurable standards teams can build to.
- An instinct for humor and comedic voice as a core tool for expressing character, with experience partnering with writers or designers to move humor from concept to something customers actually feel in the product.
- Experience defining and measuring a qualitative attribute (for example tone, sentiment, emotional response, or satisfaction) with rigorous evaluation methods.
- A strong bias for experimentation: comfortable forming hypotheses, running rapid tests, learning from ambiguous results, and iterating toward a subjective target.
- Experience using research insights (including longitudinal studies of personality perception, style evaluation, and emotional intelligence) as a primary input to strategy.
- Experience owning a horizontal or cross-cutting charter spanning many teams without direct authority.
- A background that combines the craft of character, voice, writing, or the humanities (for example philosophy, linguistics, cognitive science, or narrative and character design) with the analytical rigor to ship and measure at scale.

title: Site Process Expert, EUSC Process Excellence
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking a Site Process Expert to work in the EU Process Excellence (EUSC PE) team. The Site Process Expert is a Field onsite position and will need to adapt to local shifts requirements, depending on Operations need. The role will be based in one of our Sortation Centres (SC).

The EU PE team is a group of operational leaders driving process stabilization, standardization and continuous improvement for the EU SC network. This team is essential to establish best in class process performance across all different direct and indirect processes, accelerate implementation of technological advancements and to strengthen the technical acumen and process knowledge for the operational leaders across the SC network. EU PE ensures the operations teams are equipped with the functional expertise to successfully deliver expected gains for technology advances and network wide process improvements.

The team drives process control and shifting mean performance with the outcome of minimizing variation between shifts, building and region, to deliver strong performance. The team works closely with Core Process Experts (CPE), Change Managers (CM), Operations, Ops Excellence, Program teams, Engineering and reliability and maintenance (RME) teams to improve the input metrics for each of the process paths by prioritizing and channeling resources.

The Site Process Expert works alongside with the SC Senior Leadership Team, while keeping high collaboration with EU PE functions. This role is responsible to deploy initiatives, build networking and relationship in the SC and drive compliance for the initiatives within an assigned timeline. The Site Process Expert initiates and implements EU wide improvement activities. This role requires the ability to demonstrate ownership for initiatives, understand the initiatives in details, and influence to deliver meaningful results translating to tangible productivity and efficiency gains in the SC.

As part of this role, you will gain insights on Lean SixSigma tools and techniques and embark on a path of learning process improvement practices that will allow you to graduate as Green/Yellow Belt with this role.

Key job responsibilities
Work on Back to Basics (B2B) initiatives identifying the top opportunities in the SC in comparison with the other EU SCs. Start from the bottom 50% processes, looking for the input metrics with the biggest gap to Benchmark and implement the improvement action plan in close collaboration with the local Operations Management team following the standard improvement templates.
- Oversee the SC improvement program and set focus on most important areas, based on the alignment with the SC Senior Leadership team.
- Dive deep into the process performance by using available standard reporting or create own data analysis, call out in in the daily dive deep meetings and collect feedback from the local team to be able to convert this information into a tangible improvement plan, that matters to the SC.
- Review the open Action Plans on weekly basis, engaging the SC stakeholders to complete the suggested actions and reach the desired targets.
- Collaborate with the Process Improvement Experts team, Change Manager and other Site PEs from the same region to clarify any doubt process related and leveraging on their level of expertise. Benchmarking initiatives are highly recommended to further reduce variation across the SCs.
Work on Continuous Improvement with the SC:
- Drive network best practice implementation, leveraging local initiative led with local Ops and share them to EU PE for the review. Once approved the best practice will be officially added to all EU Best Practice repository. This process is fundamental to help the top 50% SCs to reach Best In Class through the Variation Reduction process.
- Strengthen the framework used to capture and scale SC innovation. New ideas and projects from the SC will flow through a standard process and presented to CPE for the review.
Partnership with the SC Ops:
- Join the daily Gemba on the floor with SC Leadership in order to stay aligned with SC top issues and Associate feedback.
- Support the Site Leader and the SC Senior Management Team creating a strong relationship with them, which allows the Site PE to gain their trust and buy-in for all the initiatives. Beside standard task, SPE can support Site Leader and Senior Ops on process related ad hoc tasks from the SC accounting for less than 10% of the working time.
- During Q4 you will be deployed to the site management operational team, based on the need of the building.
- Ability to travel as needed within your area of responsibility. Domestic and regional travel estimate average: 0-10%. (Subject to change based on business need).

A day in the life
You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities, analyze performance metrics, and implement solutions. You'll participate in daily operational reviews, engage with leadership teams, and help develop best practices that can be scaled across our network. Your role combines analytical thinking with relationship building to drive meaningful change.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience
- Experience in Amazon Operations as Area Manager or comparable experience

Preferred qualifications

- Strong professional experience with Lean, Six Sigma and Kaizen methodologies
- Relevant knowledge of change management and continuous improvement methodologies
- Excellent communication skills and detail orientation
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
- Ability to influence senior stakeholders in adopting change

We are looking for a senior IC who can independently drive technical decisions, scale our validation infrastructure, and raise the bar on engineering quality across the group.

Key job responsibilities
Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines — from pre-merge gates through continuous deployment to fleet.
Design and implement test frameworks that enable firmware and data-plane developers to write, run, and maintain tests with minimal friction.
Architect system-level test suites that stress control-plane and data-plane components beyond provisioning and vetting flows.
Build and maintain performance benchmarking infrastructure for LLM inference workloads (Prefill + Decode), including dashboarding and regression detection.
Drive integration of third-party vendor code (nightly drops) into CI/CD, ensuring quality gates catch regressions early.
Participate in feature design reviews, contributing test plans and challenging coverage gaps.
Define and own Continuous Testing in production environments (CTS).
Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Kiro, LLM-based code generation) to accelerate team velocity and pioneer new engineering workflows.


A day in the life
You'll start your day reviewing CI pipeline results from overnight runs, triaging failures to determine whether a regression came from a vendor code drop, a firmware change, or an ML serving stack update. Mid-morning you might pair with a hardware engineer to design test cases for a new bus-level reset flow, then pivot to extending the performance benchmarking framework to catch a latency regression. After lunch you'll join a feature design review — challenging test coverage gaps and deciding where system-level validation needs to live. The rest of your afternoon could be spent writing a new pipeline stage that gates deployment on accuracy checks, or building a dashboard that gives the group visibility into fleet-readiness metrics. Throughout the day you'll lean on AI-assisted development tools to accelerate everything from infrastructure code to root-cause analysis.

- 7+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Information Systems Security Manager , Amazon Leo Government
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about helping customers solve complex security and compliance challenges? Do you thrive in environments where you can build scalable mechanisms and drive operational excellence? Amazon Leo Government (ALG) is seeking an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to join our team.

In this role, you will help develop, design, and implement strategies to scale and manage the ALG security program in compliance with the National Industrial Security Program (NISP). We are looking for a builder with deep customer obsession who can earn trust with multiple stakeholders and deliver results in a fast-paced, high-security environment.
As an ISSM, you will own the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of Information System Security policies, standards, and directives that support the assessment, authorization, and continued operation of information systems processing classified information. You will develop and implement security policies, conduct risk assessments, manage system accreditations through the Risk Management Framework (RMF), and drive continuous monitoring efforts.

This is an individual contributor role with significant scope for ownership. You will be expected to dive deep into technical details, invent and simplify processes, and deliver results that directly impact ALG's ability to serve our government customers.


Key job responsibilities
• Own and enforce security policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure compliance with customer and NISP requirements; ensure users follow proper security procedures and all classified information systems are properly secured.
• Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, procedures, and documentation in compliance with DoD security standards and regulations (e.g., NIST, RMF, FISMA), raising the bar on quality and consistency.
• Create and maintain media sanitization (clearing, purging, or destroying) and reuse procedures, ensuring repeatable and auditable processes.
• Develop and document processes, procedures, and guidelines for protection requirements (e.g., e-mail labels, media labels), control procedures (e.g., discretionary access control, need-to-know sharing), incident management reporting, remote access requirements, system management, and use of encryption.
• Configure, update, and monitor classified network infrastructure devices including routers, firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention components, and switches; proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
• Leverage customer-authorized tools to test and secure systems, including vulnerability scanners and antivirus solutions; document findings and drive remediation.
• Perform system administration functions for modern operating systems and applications, including installing and configuring operating systems, applying patches and updates, tuning security controls to meet federal requirements, monitoring operations, and managing system backups.
• Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, or improve security processes and mechanisms; document and share best practices across the team.

This position requires the candidate to be a U.S. Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.

This position is based in Arlington VA, some travel will be required.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems Management, Information Security or other related fields
- 5+ years of experience with cybersecurity policies and implementation of Risk Management Framework (RMF), including DAAPM, CNSSI 1253, ICD-503, JSIG, or NIST SP 800 series
- Current certification in good standing to satisfy IAM Level III (CISSP, GSLC, or CISM)

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of experience as an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) or Information System Security Manager (ISSM) supporting classified programs
- Experience working in Special Access Programs (SAP)
- Working knowledge of Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs), including ICD 704, 705, and 503
- KMI Certification
- Demonstrated ability to build scalable security processes and mechanisms in a growing or dynamic environment
- Experience writing technical documentation, standard operating procedures, or runbooks
- Track record of identifying and driving process improvements in a security or compliance domain

title: Senior Program Manager; Catalog Strategy & Execution , Global Manufacturing and Distribution Services
descriptionHtml:
The Senior Program Manager of Catalog Strategy & Execution is a strategic individual contributor role within the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services organization. This position owns the critical link between enterprise procurement strategy and measurable buying behavior across Amazon. The role holder will consolidate what were previously separate project management and catalog strategy functions into a single, high-impact position that drives catalog integrity, program execution, spend compliance, and cross-functional alignment. This role also serves as the primary category liaison to the Category Strategy & Insights (CSI) team.

Key job responsibilities
This role directly supports savings targets and contributes to the broader organizational goal of net cost reductions. The position influences procurement decisions, catalog architecture, and purchasing governance across Amazon's global operations. The role holder will be instrumental in transitioning the organization from a fragmented, reactive catalog administration model to a centralized, strategic catalog function.

Essential Job Functions

Catalog Strategy & Governance: Define, own, and execute the end-to-end catalog strategy for Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services. Align catalog governance standards including taxonomy, item classification, supplier mapping, and content quality requirements with the Global Procurement Central Services team.

Program Execution & Delivery: Lead cross-functional programs that translate sourcing decisions, supplier negotiations, and manufacturing investments into measurable catalog outcomes. Manage program timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation plans.

Spend Compliance & Adoption: Design and implement frameworks that drive enterprise-wide spend compliance with preferred supplier programs and negotiated contracts. Track, analyze, and report on user adoption rates and buying behavior to identify gaps and opportunities.

CSI Category Liaison: Serve as the dedicated interface between the Global Manufacturing & Distribution Services category team and Strategic Initiatives. Ensure bi-directional alignment on procurement priorities, market intelligence, and category roadmaps.

Savings Realization: Own savings pipeline and contribute directly to annual team savings targets. Develop business cases, track savings delivery, and report on financial performance against plan.

Catalog Operations Transformation: Redesign catalog administration processes to eliminate fragmentation, reduce operational burden, and enable proactive management. Partner with technology teams to automate catalog workflows and improve data quality.

Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with sourcing managers, procurement leaders, operations teams, finance, and technology partners across multiple pillars and regions. Prepare and present program updates, savings reports, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into catalog health, programs status, adoption metrics, and savings performance. Use data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.


About the team
Global Procurement Operations (GPO) is Amazon's worldwide procurement and facilities services organization, responsible for sourcing, managing, and delivering the operational services that keep Amazon's vast network running. GPO operates at massive scale spanning more than 15 countries across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, and Latin America.
GPO's mission touches every corner of Amazon's physical operations. The organization manages strategic procurement across categories including facility services, third-party logistics (3PL), supplier management, sustainability, and site launch — ensuring Amazon's fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations are properly equipped and supported. GPO is also responsible for driving procurement innovation through technology, with a dedicated technology pillar focused on building the tools and systems that make world-class procurement possible at Amazon's scale.
The organization is structured around regional and functional centers of excellence, each led by a senior director-level leader.

GPO's corporate team includes approximately 1,400 procurement and supply chain professionals at levels working alongside a global network of on-site service partners embedded across Amazon's operational facilities. The team is highly global and distributed, with significant presence in the United States, Luxembourg, the United Kingdom, Japan, Spain, Brazil, the UAE, and beyond.

Joining GPO means working at the intersection of strategic sourcing, operational excellence, and global scale — partnering with operations, finance, legal, and sustainability teams to deliver impact across one of the world's largest and most complex supply chains.

- 6+ years of program or project management experience
- 5+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization

title: Sales Operations Lead, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about solving complex business problems, diving deep into data, driving process improvement, and leading change throughout an organization? Are you energized by putting emerging AI capabilities to work in how you operate every day? The AWS Strategic Accounts Business Operations team is seeking an experienced Sales Operations Lead to partner with our account management teams to define, land, and execute against our strategic priorities. You will partner with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams to develop standard metrics that measure the productivity and success of programs, automate and optimize operational processes, and invent new ways of diving deep with data to uncover actionable insights. You will look around corners, measure the organization's performance, supply sales leadership with timely insights on the health of their business, and manage the operating cadence for the team.

Strategic Accounts is one of AWS's most important and complex businesses — a portfolio of recognized industry leaders unlike any other segment. Working closely with senior sales leaders and executives, this role demands sharp judgment, precision, and executive-level communication: the ability to turn complexity into clear insight and to identify the true business signals that drive confident leadership decisions.

The successful candidate has excellent business and sales acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, deep analytics experience, broad technical skills, and a demonstrated ability to both execute and influence. They are willing to roll up their sleeves, dive deep to learn, work comfortably within ambiguity, and have a passion for driving operational excellence.

Above all, this role calls for someone who embodies Learn and Be Curious in the era of AI. Our business is evolving at the speed of AI, and so is how we work — we want a builder who is relentlessly curious about new AI capabilities (such as Amazon Quick), who invests the time to learn them deeply, and applies them to real problems to work faster and smarter. But curiosity goes beyond AI: it means getting to the bottom of complex business problems with many interdependencies, seeking the root cause rather than treating the symptom, and bringing a constant process-improvement mindset. The right person treats every new capability and hard problem as a chance to eliminate manual toil, surface insights earlier, and quantify the impact — in time saved or quality improved — while sharing what they learn and influencing others to adopt what works.

In this role you will provide thought leadership for the organization. You will develop unique insights that drive dynamic decision making, set high standards, and use advanced technology to enable productivity. You will build strong relationships across the organization, tie insights to business strategy and results, and act as a proactive problem-solver who looks around corners to identify, prioritize, and execute opportunities for process or data improvement.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team and business where you'll have a high impact.

Key job responsibilities
As a Sales Operations Lead, your role is critical and highly visible across the organization. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Own revenue analysis and forecast accuracy for your accounts, surfacing the "why" behind weekly and monthly trends and variance drivers in partnership with Finance and ProServe.
Drive measurable improvement in pipeline quality and hygiene, and use pipeline and revenue data to identify white space, resource optimization, and pipeline generation opportunities.
Build and run the operating cadence for your account teams, including Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, elevating them toward forward-looking risks, opportunities, and leadership actions.
Lead strategic and annual planning — territory planning, quota setting, goal setting, and account planning — and help teams turn plans into trackable, executable initiatives.
Design and manage goals and metrics mechanisms that drive accountability, and curate qualitative customer insights into timely signals for leadership.
Develop actionable, automated, self-service dashboards and reports.
Drive process improvement and change management, leading and delivering training.
Define tooling requirements and influence central teams' roadmaps to meet our high standards.
Collaborate with other Operations leads to share and implement best practices.
Lead adoption of AI tooling for operational use cases, quantifying the impact.
Prepare ad hoc analysis and participate in projects as needed.
