title: Senior Delivery Consultant, Emerging Tech
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 17, 2026

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

You bring deep solutions implementation and delivery understanding of Physical AI's building blocks (AI for automation, digital twin, robotics, edge solutions, simulation, and autonomous systems) as well as supply chain technologies. Architecting and deploying autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, digital twins, and industrial AI workloads on AWS, you'll provide secure, reliable, and scalable Physical AI infrastructure for customer innovation. You also bring a background in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, fulfillment, and the larger supply chain landscape, helping enterprise customers plan and implement the technologies to design, operate, and transform their sourcing, production, transportation, and delivery networks. You'll work with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Providing subject matter expertise on manufacturing supply chains including warehousing, logistics, fulfillment, and production-line transformation, conducting on-site assessments, identifying automation opportunities, and building customer trust through demonstrated domain knowledge
2. Owning end-to-end architecture for Physical AI solutions on AWS spanning robot or vehicle hardware, sensors, edge compute, autonomy software, simulation, cloud data and ML pipelines, and enterprise integration, and leading delivery from lab through pilot, production, and multi-site rollout
3. Building simulation, digital twin, and synthetic data pipelines (for example NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, OpenUSD, AWS IoT TwinMaker, SiteWise) and validating sim-to-real transfer on real hardware
4. Designing the fleet data loop, training, evaluating, and retraining perception models and robot policies (imitation and reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models) on SageMaker, and deploying and optimizing them on edge compute (for example NVIDIA Jetson) and industrial GPUs with TensorRT, with OTA, fleet rollout, and health monitoring through AWS IoT Greengrass components
5. Selecting and integrating robot platforms, LiDAR, cameras, GNSS/IMU, and force/torque sensors; calibrating; and integrating machine interfaces including CAN bus, drive-by-wire, PLC I/O, and E-stop circuits
6. Implementing ROS 2 or equivalent autonomy stacks (perception, SLAM, Nav2, sensor fusion, control, manipulation, fleet coordination) and integrating with PLC/SCADA, OPC UA, MQTT, WMS/MES, and fleet management systems
7. Conducting hazard analysis and building safety cases for machines operating near people, implementing safe-stop and speed-and-separation monitoring, and applying device identity, secure OTA, and OT/IT segmentation
8. Defining test plans and autonomy KPIs (stopping distance, localization error, intervention rate, pick success rate, cycle time), running closed-course and pilot-site trials and root cause analysis, and delivering runbooks, operator training, and handoff
9. Developing packaged offerings, delivery accelerators, reference architectures, demos, and training materials, and supporting pre-sales with AWS field teams and Physical AI Business Development teams


A day in the life
This team partners with our customers to assist in innovation within their business using AWS Emerging Technologies.

One week you are on a customer site with a laptop and a CAN sniffer, bringing up a new sensor stack on an autonomous vehicle and running closed-course brake tests. The next week you are in Isaac Sim randomizing lighting and textures to close a perception gap, pushing a retrained TensorRT engine to a hardware nodes fleet through Greengrass, and reviewing the safety case with the customer before pilot. Between engagements you turn what you learned into reference architectures the practice can reuse.

About the team
You'll join the AWS North American Professional Services (ProServe) Shared Delivery Team's Emerging Tech practice, a team focused on helping customers realize solutions with emerging and advanced technologies on AWS. We work directly with customers to solve their solution needs and you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including specialists, solution architects, data scientists, and engineers. Our team values hands-on builders who are curious about the intersection of business and digital systems, and we're committed to creating an environment where every team member can grow, contribute, and innovate.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience
- 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying robotics, autonomous systems, or industrial automation (for example AMR/AGV, robotic arms, autonomous vehicles, drones, humanoids, legged robots, or production-line automation systems)
- Experience with ROS 2 or equivalent robotics middleware
- Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical/Computer/Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
- Experience programming in Python and C++

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Professional level certification
- 3+ years implementing Physical AI projects such as digital twin or simulation environments, robot policy or perception model training, autonomous system deployment, ROS 2 or equivalent robotics middleware integration, or edge inference on Jetson-class hardware
- Delivery experience across two or more of: warehouse or production-line automation, AMR/AGV or robotic-arm deployment, autonomous vehicle or drone deployment, industrial digital twin or simulation, edge AI and computer vision, OT integration, or supply chain and manufacturing optimization
- Familiarity with the AWS Physical AI stack (Physical AI Toolchain on AWS, IoT Core, Greengrass v2, SiteWise, TwinMaker, SageMaker, Bedrock, Kinesis Video Streams, S3/Glue/Athena, EKS or Batch, CDK) and the NVIDIA robotics stack (Isaac Sim/Lab/ROS, Omniverse, OpenUSD, Jetson, TensorRT, CUDA)

descriptionHtml:

Horario: Disponibilidad para rolar turnos día, noche y fines de semana

Nuestra misión en Amazon es ser la empresa más centrada en el cliente de la Tierra, y nuestro galardonado equipo de Reliability Maintenance Engineering es una parte clave para lograr ese objetivo. Amazon es una de las marcas más reconocidas en el mundo porque distribuimos millones de productos a nuestros clientes. Hacer nuestro mejor esfuerzo por nuestros clientes es de donde obtenemos nuestra energía, y es por eso que encontrará que abordamos las cosas de manera diferente aquí.

El equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad (RME) de Amazon es fundamental para nuestras operaciones: son ellos quienes mantienen la maquinaria vital en funcionamiento en todo momento. Como técnico de RME, mantendrá una amplia gama de equipos y espacios de trabajo manteniendo al mismo tiempo las mejores prácticas de salud y seguridad. Ayudará a mantener seguros a sus colegas y evitará el tiempo de inactividad de la máquina. Nuestros técnicos de RME aumentan la disponibilidad y la calidad de nuestros equipos y también trabajan para mejorar el entorno operativo.

Key job responsibilities
- Tareas de mantenimiento proactivo y preventivo de una amplia gama de equipos de obra.
- Realizar reparaciones reactivas y diagnóstico de fallas en un centro de distribución en funcionamiento.
- Utilizar las herramientas más recientes para maximizar la efectividad del equipo.
- Mantener todas las políticas y prácticas de salud y seguridad.
- Apoyar el desarrollo y progresión de los aprendices en sitio.
- Trabajar en proyectos de mejora continua e implementar mejores prácticas en varios sitios en México.

A day in the life
Nuestros técnicos de RME están ubicados en el sitio para que puedan responder rápidamente a cualquier problema con la maquinaria. Llevará a cabo una serie de mantenimiento preventivo planificado en los equipos de nuestros sitios para garantizar que funcionen de manera segura. Como técnico de RME, también responderá con prontitud a las averías, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluciones lo más rápido posible. También hará sugerencias para mejoras a largo plazo.

Trabajando junto a colegas más experimentados, llevará a cabo tareas de mantenimiento diarias y se comunicará con contratistas si necesita experiencia externa. Podrá trabajar en una variedad de turnos para garantizar que nuestros sitios tengan soporte las 24 horas del día, lo que permitirá a Amazon realizar entregas a la velocidad por la que somos conocidos.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de Ingeniería de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad o RME mantiene nuestros equipos funcionando con su mejor rendimiento. Somos un equipo con mentalidad técnica, formado por excelentes jugadores de equipo y guiados por líderes experimentados. Trabajamos juntos para mantener, solucionar problemas y reparar equipos en nuestra red global de centros de distribución. Algunos de nuestros empleados son líderes que supervisan el equipo mientras trabajan en tecnologías interesantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.

Desde la instalación de sistemas de embalaje automatizados hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un sitio web y la reparación de equipos de distribución clave, nuestro equipo maneja la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon. Esto incluye mantener los edificios cumpliendo con la ley, garantizar que todos estén seguros y que nuestros sitios funcionen con la máxima eficiencia. Hay muchas oportunidades de progresión, tanto dentro del equipo de RME como en general en Amazon.

Trabajamos para reducir el tiempo de inactividad en los sitios de operaciones críticos de Amazon para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Si identificamos una mejor manera de hacer algo, tenemos las habilidades y la oportunidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos completamente nuevos o tecnologías de vanguardia.

title: Financial Planning PM, JCFS
descriptionHtml:
JCFSでは、JCFSプロジェクト担当者、Finance、Procurementと連携し、複数チームをまたいで小規模な財務計画・予算管理プログラムをオーナーするFinancial Planning PMを求めています。難易度の高い部門横断的な計画業務を自立的に、期限と品質を守ってデリバリーすることがミッションです。
このロールでは、プロジェクトコストのモニタリングとコントロール、四半期メカニズムによるコスト超過・乖離の早期発見、そして迅速な是正アクションの推進を通じて、JCFSのプロジェクト財務管理の強化を支援します。財務計画サイクル全体のコミュニケーションをオーナーし、ブロッカーを解消し、適切にエスカレーションしてデリバリーを軌道に乗せます。また、JCFSの投資計画とプロジェクト財務ステータスをAmazon Japanオペレーションリーダーシップに対して明確に報告します。グローバルのカウンターパートから優れた財務管理のベストプラクティスを学び、計画プロセスについて他者へのメンタリングを始めることも期待されます。

JCFS seeks a Financial Planning PM to own a small, well-defined financial planning and budgeting program for JCFS projects, working across teams in close partnership with JCFS project owners, Finance, and Procurement. You will deliver cross-functional planning work on time and to quality.
In this role you help JCFS strengthen project financial management by monitoring project costs, identifying cost overruns or variances early through a quarterly mechanism, and driving timely corrective actions. You own program communication for the financial planning cycle, clearing blockers and escalating appropriately to keep delivery on track. You also prepare and deliver clear reporting on JCFS’s investment plans and project financial status to Finance and Operations Leadership. You are encouraged to learn best financial-management practices from your global counterparts and begin to mentor others on the planning process.


Key job responsibilities
• JCFSの各チームリーダーおよびプロジェクト担当者、Financeと連携し、財務計画・予算・コストコントロールのプロセスを設計・運用します。迅速かつ明快な意思決定を推進し、業務のスコープをコントロールします。
• 四半期メカニズムを活用し、コスト超過・乖離・プロジェクト遅延の可能性を先回りで特定し、適切な問いを投げかけ、コストを計画通りに保つための投機を実行します。
• Operations FinanceおよびProcurementと連携し、プロジェクト予算計画や収益性見込み、物品調達状況を確認し、プロジェクト毎の財務リスクを見える化します。
• JCFSのプロジェクト投資計画、収益性、四半期のリスク・オポチュニティ評価を明確かつ簡潔なビジネスドキュメントにまとめ、Leadershipへ報告します。改善が必要な場合は、プロジェクト関係者と連携して実行計画とアクションを策定・推進します。
• グローバルステークホルダーと連携し、優れたプロセスやツール、方法論を積極的に学び、JPへの導入を推進します。
• Create and run a financial planning, budgeting, and cost-control process with JCFS stakeholders (team leaders and project owners) and Finance; drive crisp, timely decisions and keep the scope of effort under control.
• Using the quarterly mechanism, proactively identify potential cost overruns, variances, or project delays, surface the right questions, and implement appropriate measures to keep costs in line.
• Partner with Operations Finance and Procurement to validate project budget plans, profitability outlooks, and procurement status, and make project-level financial risks visible.
• Prepare a clear, concise business document reporting JCFS’s project investment plan, financial viability, and quarterly risk-and-opportunity assessment to Leadership; where improvements are needed, coordinate with stakeholders to define and drive action plans.
• Seek and learn best practices from other geographies and work with global stakeholders to adopt their tools, standard processes, and methodologies in Japan.

A day in the life
・ 毎週のPMチームミーティングを開催し、JCFSのビジネス状況に関する情報をアップデートします。
・ 他チームや組織との連携が必要な場合は、関係部門の担当者と協力して要件を明確化し、ビジネスゴールに沿って優先順位を整理し、リーダーの意思決定を支援します。
・ JCFSメンバーとともにFCやSort Centerなどのオペレーション拠点を訪問し、JCFSのビジネスと技術を学びます。
・ Hold a weekly PM team meeting to update information about the JCFS business situation.
・ When collaboration with other teams or organizations is needed, work with representatives from other departments to clarify requirements and align prioritization with business goals to support leadership decision-making.
・ Visit operational sites such as FCs and Sort Centers together with JCFS members to learn about JCFS business and technology.

About the team
オペレーション技術統括本部（JCFS: Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions）はAmazon Japanオペレーションの技術・ソリューション開発部門として、物流プロセス、設備、自動化技術の設計・開発・導入・改善を行います。JCFSのミッションは技術革新を通じて「品揃え」「低価格」「利便性」を継続的に向上させること、そして顧客ニーズに合わせた次世代のFulfillment Solutionsを創出し最高の購買体験を実現することです。JCFS PMチームはJCFSを横断したリソース（ヒト・モノ・カネ）計画の策定と管理、プロジェクト財務の予実管理、プロセス標準化と変更管理といったプロジェクトマネジメント機能を担います。
Japan Customer Fulfillment Solutions (JCFS) develops innovative fulfillment and automation solutions to deliver an excellent customer experience. Our mission is to continuously improve item selection, convenience, and price through technological innovation, and to update our fulfillment solutions to meet fast-changing customer needs. The JCFS PM team manages JCFS resource plans to deliver projects, controls project budgets, and standardizes the change management process.

- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience

This role will partner with site leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost within the Inbound network.

title: Software Development Manager, Ring Video Platform
descriptionHtml:
The Ring Video Platform Team innovates in the video streaming space for Ring cameras. We are passionate about helping customers see what matters at home, whenever they need to. Every day, millions of Ring devices stream, record and process video through services we build and operate. At that scale we hold ourselves to a high bar for reliability, latency, video quality and privacy.

We're looking for a technically deep Software Development Manager to lead one of our video platform teams. This role suits someone who enjoys the engineering as much as the people side. There's real room to innovate: real-time video at this scale raises hard problems, and many of them have no off-the-shelf answer.

We're also changing how we build software. AI is becoming part of every stage of our development lifecycle, from design and coding through review, testing and operations. The Ring Video Platform organization, based in Cambridge/London, builds and operates the cloud services that power Ring video, from the moment a camera starts streaming to when a customer watches it on their phone. title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

title: Embedded Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join this ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in distributed systems and software design. Come work at Amazon!

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.



Key job responsibilities
Design, implement, and enhance the switch-management software — from translating routes received from a centralized SDN controller into forwarding-table entries, to building MAC-learning and loop-prevention logic for a redundant switch topology — that enables deterministic, low-latency packet forwarding across the constellation

Design and optimize the networking layers of flight software for optical inter-satellite link systems, spanning network device drivers and protocol implementations on embedded Linux

Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including hardware, optics, systems, communications, and operations engineers — to integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems and the networking stack that underpins space-based connectivity

Build and extend operational tooling for network diagnostics and observability — including routing-table inspection, packet capture and analysis, structured logging, and metrics emission — that enables rapid fault isolation and performance trending across the satellite mesh



A day in the life
As a Software Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link team, you won't just write code — you'll see it fly. Your software will control and monitor high-speed laser communications between satellites moving at orbital velocities, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and ground-based verification to watching your code commission an optical link for the first time in orbit. On the networking side, you'll design and debug the switching fabric that routes traffic across the constellation — ensuring packets traverse inter-satellite links with minimal latency and maximum reliability.




About the team
You will join a multi-disciplinary team of exceptional engineers whose work spans an unusually broad scope: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built.

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience in Linux and Networking protocols

Preferred qualifications

- Experience developing embedded software for space systems, including optical communication systems, laser terminals, or high-speed serial interfaces
- Experience with ARM-based SoCs

title: Assistant Brand Manager, Sports, Amazon, Sports GL
descriptionHtml:

As a Retail Vendor Manager at Amazon, you'll serve as a strategic brand manager responsible for delivering measurable business impact through data-driven merchandizing and cross-channel optimization. You'll own critical input metrics that directly influence brand growth, managing everything from traffic channels and promotional strategies to customer experience design across category pages.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of merchandizing, marketing, and operations. You'll experiment with innovative tactics to increase conversion rates, design compelling store-wide promotions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges. Your analytical insights and stakeholder management skills will drive learning from campaigns, establish best practices, and optimize the customer journey across Sports categories.

Key job responsibilities
Manage multiple traffic channels for select products including site merchandizing, outbound marketing, affiliate marketing, SEO, and search engine marketing initiatives to drive brand visibility and customer engagement
Design and execute store-wide promotions by collaborating closely with Category Managers and Instock Managers to schedule, implement, and optimize promotional campaigns that enhance customer experience

Our team values collaboration, analytical rigor, and proactive problem-solving as we work together to optimize the customer journey and drive business growth. We foster an environment where experimentation is encouraged, insights are shared openly, and every team member contributes to establishing best practices that scale across the organization. This role provides exposure across multiple departments and offers opportunities to build relationships with brand partners, category teams, and program specialists while making a meaningful impact on how customers discover and engage with products.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Last Mile Rental (LMR) team is redefining how we power last-mile delivery by ensuring the right vehicles are in the right hands at the right time — at scale. As well as external strategic partner relationships such as Fleet Management Companies (FMC), Fleet Providers, and Service Vendors. We operate as a strategic orchestrators, balancing tactical urgency with long-term planning to keep Amazon's delivery fleet running at peak efficiency. Our work exists in high-visibility, high-impact environment where your decisions directly influence delivery capacity for millions of customers and every cost penny saved translates to millions captured in downstream impact.

title: Sr Security Assurance Specialist Australia, AWS Security Assurance
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. The AWS Security Assurance team is responsible for demonstrating the security controls of services offered by AWS. At our scale, we invent new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our most security conscious customers. Our team works closely with customers across industries and their auditors and regulatory agencies to understand the security shift from on-premise to the cloud, security of the cloud and customer capabilities in the cloud.

Our Assurance Specialists ensure that AWS can meet customers audit, assurance and regulatory expectations. We are looking for an independent, passionate, and deeply experienced security audit specialist with expertise and experience in developing and implementing technology audit and assurance programs in Australia. You will be responsible for defining and developing an audit and assurance program for our customers in Australia, along with hiring and managing the team that will work in specific markets.

At our scale, we are committed to inventing new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our most security conscious customers. You have a strong foundation in audit principles, as well as a diverse technology, privacy and assurance background.

You have led teams and delivered challenging and complex audit and assurance programs. We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect team members and management alike to take a high degree of ownership for their program, vision and execution.

We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. You will have an opportunity to work directly with most divisions across AWS as we build the tools and evidence needed to demonstrate assurance for our customers.  Your technical and audit background will help bridge security, technology, and compliance, and facilitate the scale of the program.

This role, as part of the AWS Compliance & Security Assurance team in Australia, requires the ability to develop long-term projects and define processes and methods to ensure execution and productivity across multiple internal and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory agencies.

Key job responsibilities
- Delivery of commercial and cleared audits programs in Australia  (SOC, IRAP, DISP, etc.)
- Support audit evidence collection and project delivery as needed for other APAC countries
- Serve as an expert to AWS, customers, auditors, and regulators on regional and domestic regulations on security, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, technology, outsourcing and operational resilience in the industry.
- Innovate to develop mechanisms that continuously improve the customer experience of security assurance;
- Performing compliance impact and market assessments of emerging compliance programs;
- Tracking and reporting on changes to security controls and requirements standards across the region;
- Manage tight deadlines and drive for results, while being extremely detail orientated
- Prepare project plans and track projects through fruition.
- Support metrics, implement data collections mechanisms, analyze data and make recommendations.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Data Center Facility Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Ensure staffing levels are maintained and grow with expansions

- Coordinate daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs

title: Sr Retail Manager - Premium Beauty, Retail Consumables
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Brazil is looking for a dynamic Retail Manager to play an important role within the Retail team by adding selection, analyzing business data, driving vendor performance, negotiating terms and handling promotions. As a Retail Manager, you will report to the head of category and developing relationships with several of our key vendors and partners. You will work with Brazilian and global vendors to drive all aspects of terms improvements, which includes analysis and projections, as well as direct negotiations with decision makers in local vendors. Additionally, you will increase product category sales, by driving store marketing promotions, negotiating partners to improve selection, and reacting to industry-related economic trends.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication, the ability to analyze and communicate complex terms and margin structure and work well across other teams including Finance, Marketing and Inventory Management. Candidates who are organized, flexible, creative, analytical, and able to drive negotiations through completion will be highly appreciated. Strong ownership values, a real passion for innovation, and hustle are also key to succeed in this position.
If you are passionate about e-commerce and career growth, this opportunity with Amazon.com.br is for you!

Key job responsibilities
Retail Managers focus on and act at the intersection of customers, vendors, and functional teams:

- Customers: They rely on specialized teams for customer and category information and insights, and works with and influences other teams to get the category-specific customer needs addressed. The Retail Manager is responsible to hold category-specific knowledge about customers and their needs, emerging product trends and the market segment evolution, and new business opportunities.
- Vendors: RM are the ultimate owners of the vendor relationship, with a direct focus on the top vendors that drive the vast majority of sales. They are directly responsible for auditing and escalating performance, improving overall terms and cost structures of the relationship by means of negotiation, and for developing long term partnerships with new and existing vendors to drive topline and selection fueling category growth.
- Central and Functional Teams: As a business owner, the RM represents customer and business needs in interaction with central teams, projects and initiatives. The Retail Manager drives central teams for the evolution of customer-facing and internal systems to improve the customer experience from the category perspective. At the same time, they implements centrally driven initiatives within the category to drive CX or cost improvements, even more important prioritize based on impact and potential tradeoffs, and if need be pushing back on selected initiatives.

A day in the life
Retail Managers are owners of the Retail business. Either for subcategories or subgroup of vendors they own the respective business end-to-end including the entire P&L, from topline down to free cash flow. They manage inputs by driving selection, securing great prices and increasing convenience/speed to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel. While they focus their activities on our most strategically relevant vendors and holdouts, they audit and escalate the performance of lower tiered vendors.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in account management, project/program management, or buying
- Experience with business analysis and P&L management
- Experience using data to influence business decisions
- Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams

title: Network Development Engineer, GCNA-D
descriptionHtml:
Do you like to use network and Unix systems engineering to deliver simple, sustainable and repeatable solutions? Would you like your work to play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation IP networks?

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
The AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) Organization is looking for a Network Development Engineer to join our EDGE team. Network Development Engineers partner with our broader Infrastructure organization on configurations standards and tools, and collaborate with Systems and Software Engineers to ensure fast, smooth roll-out of new designs and products, and also deploy and sustain networking software tools.

AWS GCNA (Global Connectivity and Network Availability) is the backbone that connects the global
AWS network. Focused on controlling the internet traffic that allows users to access their information
and applications regardless of where they are in the world. GCNA is responsible for building and
designing a complex backbone network that allows internet traffic to flow efficiently between data
centers and customers.


Key job responsibilities
Network Development Engineers will:
• Be responsible for deploying network infrastructure across all of our network fabrics that supports the Amazon Retail Service, Kindle, Payments and multiple AWS services.
• Deploy, scale and automate our network across multiple global datacenters. This includes existing footprints and greenfield locations.
• Drive scaling of current network designs to meet the demand of our customers.
• Create simple, repetitive deployment processes that increase both velocity and quality.
• Work closely with our internal customers on designs/solutions; bringing those designs/solutions from concept to production.
• Create and update our network standards and ensure that the network is deployed to these standards.
• Create and implement changes on the network.
• Work closely with our automation teams in defining the tools that allow us to scale at higher volume.


A day in the life
Engineers in the Internet Edge organization have a wide range of responsibilities: we evolve routing policy, implement traffic engineering solutions, grow our peering footprint, secure the “front door” from bad actors on the Internet, and architect the hardware platforms and network design to support any Amazon product that needs to reach end-users worldwide. Our infrastructure moves terabits of traffic to and from the Internet at any given moment, and represents one of the largest edge surface areas in the world, requiring complex solutions to ensure that capacity always stays ahead of demand. To accomplish that, our engineers develop automation, write software, and work with a wide range of partner teams to continually improve and automate our Internet connectivity in areas such as capacity delivery, configuration deployment, impairment detection, and traffic optimization. Internet Edge engineers make decisions on both a day-to-day and long-term strategic basis, which carry a large amount of responsibility and impact across all of Amazon’s products.
• Support an off-hours operations escalation pager rotation.
• Manage customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure.
• Sit at the computer during scheduled work hours with appropriate breaks while maintaining a high level of alertness and attention to detail.
• Travel to data center/network sites and Amazon/customer offices as needed.


About the team
Internet Edge provides high-performing Internet connectivity for a wide range of use cases, such as retail (amazon.com), video streaming (Prime Video), content delivery (CloudFront), DNS (Route53), AWS services (such as EC2/S3), consumer devices (such as FireTV/Kindle/Echo), and more.

Within AWS Networking, the Internet Edge organization is responsible for connecting Amazon to the global Internet. With connections to thousands of unique external networks in hundreds of locations across the world, our mission is to deliver an Internet connectivity experience that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security, and cost, making Amazon the clear choice for our customers’ needs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals and extensive experience in the application of IP protocols
- Knowledge of network analysis fundamentals and robust troubleshooting
- Experience in major internet routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
- Experience with network operating systems such as Cisco IOS and Junos
- Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of IT best practice frameworks (ITIL, COBIT) and operational excellence concepts or methodologies
- Knowledge of network hardware and packet forwarding architectures
- Experience with Unix and scripting in Perl, shell, C or C++
- Experience working with customers to diagnose a problem and work towards resolution

descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.

We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.

You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.

Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.

Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.

Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary. As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis. The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.

- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager (Indirect), Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company. Our passion for invention leads us to pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings daily. As we rapidly become the world's largest consumer of corporate services in many categories, the Corporate Strategic Procurement team is seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to join our team. This role is uniquely positioned at the nexus of business units across Amazon, and offers singular vision into a broad spectrum of cross-company initiatives and strategies on a global scale. Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decisionmaking rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team. Successful candidates must work well in a fast-paced and often ambiguous arena, and will be rewarded by working alongside highly collaborative and entrepreneurial colleagues in an environment that feels much more "startup" than "big company". Spend categories under management include indirect categories such as Logistics, Technology, such as Software, Hardware, Data Purchase, Telecommunication, Cybersecurity, among others. If you are an experienced sourcing professional with a passion for serving customers and for driving change and impact on a global scale, then we would love to talk with you.

Key job responsibilities
Owning one or more complex (sub-)categories across multiple business units and/or regions, developing and executing (sub-)category strategies
Developing global sourcing strategies to deliver against business objectives for internal clients, and achieving sustainable relationships with suppliers.
Managing categories in markets with limited competition and limited pricing transparency, proactively identifying and mitigating supplier, commercial, and ESG risk.
Evaluating supplier core competencies and competitive positioning using industry cost models and bench-marking analysis.
Managing the fundamentals of sourcing and supplier engagement activities, including RFx, spend pattern analysis, contract analysis, bid evaluation, negotiations, and supplier consolidation.
Leading transformational sourcing projects with complex, global scope, coordinating work across team members and regions.
Working with business and finance leaders to identify and drive savings and controllership improvements, focusing on total cost of ownership, and value creation beyond cost savings.
Presenting sourcing strategies, recommendations, and decisions to senior leaders up to three levels above you.
Contributing inputs to annual and long-range operating plans (OP1, OP2, and three-year forecast).
Providing guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement processes and maintaining procurement ethics in accordance with Amazon's global policies.
Preparing and holding business reviews with stakeholders to review vendor performance, future opportunities, and/or challenges.
Mentoring and sharing best practices with sourcing peers across the global team.


A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you're on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You'll close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you'll balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.





About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate & Facilities. We're a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. You'll be joining a team where your work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, etc.)
- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in categories such as logistics, professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
- Experience managing spend categories that include three or more of the following: Logistics, IT Software, IT
- Services, Corporate Services, Marketing, Contingent labor, Facilities and Real estate, Capital Expenditure and Tail Spend (Indirect Categories)

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a non-mandated, indirect procurement function at a multinational corporation
- Experience owning complex sourcing categories across multiple business units and/or regions
- Experience managing categories in markets with limited competition or limited pricing transparency, including proactive supplier risk management
- Experience leading transformational or cross-regional sourcing initiatives with global scope
- Experience advising and presenting sourcing strategy to senior executives and influencing C-level vendor relationships
- Experience contributing to annual or long-range operating plans
- Experience mentoring peers or coordinating sourcing work across a distributed team

title: Site EHS Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate well being while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS SecDevOps
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security SecDevOps is a team of software development engineers responsible for shaping the future of internal security tooling within AWS Security. We build technologies at scale to help keep AWS and our customers secure. As a software development engineer on this team, you will use modern technologies and AWS services to empower AWS security response engineers to be more productive and improve AWS builder experience. Our team tackles challenging internal development efforts within AWS Security requiring scale, availability, and integration with numerous other services and tools. To delight our customers we incorporate real-time collaboration features and use purpose-built components and dependencies, while maintaining close contact with our customers throughout the development process.

You are a software developer who likes to deliver software solutions that solve business problems and delight your customers with efficiency and productivity gains. You have development experience with technologies like AWS, Java, TypeScript, React, Python, and SQL, though you don't need experience with all of those to start. You might be a front end developer, a back end developer, or a full stack engineer. If you have some background in security that is helpful, but not required.

- Design and deliver software features across the full development lifecycle, from working backwards with customers through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations, for security response systems.
- Participate actively in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to teammates and coaching others on producing high-quality, maintainable code.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, ensuring the software you support remains reliable and that permanent fixes replace short-term workarounds.
- Collaborate with customers, other technical teams, and stakeholders to collect requirements, understand business and security needs, and translate those into clear technical solutions.
- Document the software you work on, how it is constructed and operated, and how it fits into the broader security ecosystem, and train new team members on these points.

You review the operational health of detection and response systems, checking metrics and addressing any service issues. You design and implement features across front end, back end and data warehousing. You participate in design discussions and code reviews with your teammates, and regularly meet with security response engineers and AWS builders to understand their pain points so you can build the right solutions. You also spend time mentoring teammates and writing documentation that helps others ramp up quickly.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: BIE II, SCOT NEST
descriptionHtml:
As a Business Intelligence Engineer in Network Evolution Science & Tech (NEST), you will own the design, development, and delivery of reporting and measurement solutions that power the global expansion of our flagship planning platforms — UPX (Unified Planner Experience) and CPF/UPO (the coordination and optimization layer) — into emerging fulfillment networks worldwide.

You will work at the intersection of supply chain planning, operational intelligence, and optimization-model performance. Your reporting products will directly inform decisions that affect planner productivity, plan quality, and automation adoption as we scale from a single network in production to the full universe of non-core networks: Sub Same Day, Quick Commerce, Distribution Centres (SDC/1DC/rDC), AMXL, Rural and Super Rural+, AWD, and more, across all regions. You will design the measurement frameworks that show whether each new network launch is delivering accurate, trusted, adopted plans — before gaps reach decision-makers. And you will own the reporting suite that keeps the NEST function accountable to launch milestones, model performance, and benefits realisation.

You will operate independently, managing ambiguity with rigor and judgment — much of what you measure does not exist yet and will be defined as networks onboard. You will partner closely with Science, Engineering, Product, S&OP planning teams, UPO/UPX platform partners, and Finance. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior leadership, influence launch and prioritisation decisions through data-backed arguments, and contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of automated BI reporting that measures UPX and CPF/UPO expansion across every network × country — model accuracy, planner adoption, plan-vs-actuals, and benefits realisation.
Build the network launch and adoption measurement framework: dashboards and pipelines tracking optimisation-model accuracy, planner cycle time, adoption rates, and manual-process retirement as networks onboard (Sub Same Day, Quick Commerce, SDC, 1DC, rDC, AMXL, Rural and Super Rural+, AWD).
Design model-performance and plan-quality guardrail reporting with scalable alerting that flags when outputs or upstream signals breach thresholds, enabling proactive intervention.
Own the BAU reporting suite: weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR/QBR packs, peak readiness dashboards, launch-milestone tracking, and forecast-accuracy reporting.
Architect dimensional data models and ETL pipelines integrating upstream signals, UPO/CPF, UPX, and network planning tools into a single source of truth.
Drive metric standardisation across networks by partnering with Science, S&OP, and platform teams on definitions, methodologies, and data quality.
Independently apply AI tools to automate reporting workflows and improve speed, quality, and self-service.
Translate deep-dive analyses into narratives for Director- to VP-level audiences, and own data quality, pipeline reliability, SLAs, and on-call support.

About the team
Network Evolution Science & Tech (NEST) team owns planning optimization for networks outside the core FC network — 8 network types across 12 countries and 2,000+ non-core nodes (Sub Same Day, SDC, 1DC, rDC, Quick Commerce, Grocery, Rural and Super Rural+, AMXL, AWD). Our north star: every planner creates, analyses, and publishes plans through automated optimization on UPX — no spreadsheets, no tribal knowledge. Spanning operations research, optimization modelling, data science, and program management, we automate planning so S&OP capacity scales sub-linearly as the network grows. We're now building the reporting foundation that makes this expansion visible, measurable, and governable.

- 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
- 1+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
- 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
- 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
- 3+ years of in the job offered or a related occupation experience
- 1+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience

- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred qualifications

We deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries. In addition to working alongside our customers, we share our experience through technical artifacts and proof of concept demos.

This internship can lead to a full-time role in Arlington, VA, or New York City, NY, that has up to 75% travel associated. Delivery Consultants in AWS ProServe are aligned by technical specialty. For this internship, we are looking for candidates that are interested in and fit the AIML specialty.

The program offers the opportunity to specialize in an area of interest including:
AIML - AIML role supports our services that leverage data and produce business insights, which may include using Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence/Generative Artificial Intelligence (ML/AI/GenAI). Helping our customers use and integrate Big Data services in what is arguably our industry’s most exciting space. Modernization - Modernization resources are specialists in designing applications that run natively in the cloud using programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, Typescript, etc. They are experts in building programs that run on any number of platforms including virtualized instances, containers, or server less architecture. They are full stack developers with backend, frontend, and UX skillsets.

About the team

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Controls team
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
· Primarily work in and support multiple Data Centers by Deploying, Servicing, and Upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
· Mentor and train Facilities team members on operation and control of the BMS and EPMS systems.
· Audit, maintain, and manage computer enterprise asset management systems for BMS and EPMS installations
· Manage small to medium size projects and programs.
· Perform point to point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
· Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with the BMS and EPMS in data centers.
· Perform provisioning process for servers, controllers, industrial PCs and network configurations and communication testing between third party devices and controllers or servers.
· Installation, replacement, configuration, and calibration of sensors.
· Able to read and understand Electrical schematics, control panel drawings. Basic understanding of close loop controls, field sensors scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
· Supervise low voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
· Commissioning and systems level testing support.
· Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
· Follow change management process to generate work requests and method of procedures.
· Participate in Factory witnessed tests at vendors or in panel builders facility.
· Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.
· Recommend design improvements based on consultation with users and system operation.
· Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
· Ensure all personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
· Work on-call and a rotating schedule when required and respond to after-hours emergencies.
· Perform service activities such as monitoring/reviewing ticketing systems, performing root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
· Actively manage service agreements to include vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

or crawl.

A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritising routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.
Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analysing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.
