title: Sr Product Marketing Manager, Amazon Supply Chain Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS) is transforming how businesses move products, making Amazon's world-class logistics infrastructure available to shippers of all sizes. Amazon Shipping is the ASCS parcel delivery arm, providing fast and reliable delivery for shippers sending packages both inbound to Amazon and to their own customers through their website or other sales channels. Our team drives go-to-market, messaging, and sales enablement for Amazon Shipping, growing awareness and adoption among shippers from SMB through Enterprise.

Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy and execution for Amazon Shipping. In this role, you will own the GTM plan for the business, develop and deploy communications to target shipper audiences across multiple channels, and monitor adoption to identify opportunities for additional impact. You will translate a technically and operationally complex delivery product into a clear, provable value proposition for customers who have many shipping options, and you will run regular campaign analysis to improve processes and outputs with an emphasis on continuous improvement. This is a fast-paced, high-impact role that requires you to work hand in glove with Product Managers, Engineers, Operators, Commercial teams, Finance partners, and parallel marketing organizations to bring meaningful value to shippers.

Our environment is fast-paced and innovative, and we are looking for a candidate who is flexible and thrives in ambiguity, excels in cross-functional influence and collaboration, and can think strategically while paying careful attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities
- Build a compelling go-to-market strategy for Amazon Shipping products and services, driving shipper acquisition and volume growth

- Define the priorities, roadmap, and operating plan to reach and exceed annual GTM goals across domestic parcel delivery offerings

- Lead GTM initiatives end to end in close collaboration with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial/Business Development, Finance, and the broader marketing team

- Develop and deploy marketing collateral and communications across paid, owned, and partner channels

- Deeply understand shippers and their needs across segments (SMB and Enterprise); ensure every marketing activity resonates with customers, creating meaningful engagement and driving adoption of Amazon Shipping services

- Own positioning and competitive differentiation, translating operational strengths that customers may never see directly into clear reasons to choose Amazon Shipping

- Develop KPIs to carefully manage and measure the impact of GTM campaigns, spend, and adoption

- Enable Commercial and sales teams with the messaging, collateral, and talking points that help them win and retain shippers

- Influence executive leaders through narratives, representing the Shipping marketing perspective in planning forums

- Conduct regular campaign analysis to continuously improve processes, outputs, and ROI

- Navigate ambiguity, challenge skepticism, and take on the hardest problems, willing to fail in the name of learning what works best over the long term

A day in the life
In this role you own the marketing strategy for Amazon Shipping and the day-to-day work that brings it to life. You partner closely with internal stakeholders across Product and Engineering (to understand what is being built and shape how it is positioned), Commercial and Business Development (to arm sales with messaging and collateral that win and retain shippers), Operations (to ground the story in what the delivery network actually does), and Finance (to tie marketing spend and goals to business outcomes). You also represent the Shipping marketing perspective in leadership planning forums.

Your customers are shippers, from SMBs sending a handful of packages to Enterprises moving high volume, who are deciding whether to trust Amazon with their deliveries when they already have other carrier options. The core problems you solve are making a complex, infrastructure-heavy delivery product easy to understand, giving shippers clear and provable reasons to choose Amazon Shipping, and translating operational strengths they may never see directly into a compelling value proposition.

Concretely, you move between building and executing GTM plans for launches, developing positioning and messaging, helping produce campaigns across paid, owned, and partner channels, analyzing adoption and campaign performance to decide what to do next, writing narratives for business reviews, and building the mechanisms that let all of this scale as the business grows.

About the team
We are the Product Marketing team within Amazon Supply Chain Services, sitting at the intersection of product, commercial, and the customer. Our work shapes how shippers understand and adopt Amazon Shipping, translating what the network does into reasons to choose it. We are a high-ownership, cross-functional team, partnering daily with Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Business Development, and Finance. We value people who bring structure to ambiguity, think like business owners, and care as much about whether the message landed as whether it shipped. You will have the autonomy to own a business and the support of a team that moves fast and learns in the open.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Mechanical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective mechanical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

We are looking for engineers with hands on mechanical design experience. If you can design a mechanical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the mechanical engineering field. At Amazon we do highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a mechanical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.
Amazon has a global presence. Travel will occasionally be necessary but shouldn’t be more than 20%. International support will be part of the job, some international travel may be necessary. Support could consist of working on international teams and could require developing detailed schematic design packages. An understanding of international mechanical design requirements is helpful but not necessary.

Key job responsibilities:

- Work with internal teams to understand user requirements.

- Data center mechanical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.

- Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.

- Work with regional vendors and manufactures to specify the appropriate mechanical equipment.

- Work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements.

- Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with city/county requirements and building codes.

- Review and approval of equipment submittals.

- Define project scopes and provide technical support for information requests during construction phases.

- Work with commissioning teams to properly validate installation, operation, and performance of mechanical systems.

- Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.

- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, engineering evaluations, mechanical systems audits, and startup as needed.

- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

This position will be available in Herndon, VA or Seattle, WA

Basic qualifications

- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent engineering degree in a related field with at least 4 years of additional qualifying experience.
- 6+ years of experience in engineering design or the construction industry, related to all aspects of Mechanical , including hydronics, air side duct design, and plumbing design.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

title: Software Development Engineer - Network Observability, Leo Networking Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s Low Earth Orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will connect people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team builds the systems that provide deep, end-to-end insight into the health, performance, and reliability of this global telecom network. Our systems span the full Leo service—from satellites and customer terminals to ground gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure—and enable engineers to understand network behavior, rapidly detect failures, and diagnose complex issues across space and ground infrastructure.
We are looking for a talented Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate network observability and analytics solutions for an advanced global telecommunications service spanning both space and terrestrial networks.

As a software engineer on this team, you will build high-scale systems that transform telemetry, network events, traces, and operational signals into actionable visibility. You will work across distributed systems, networking, data pipelines, real-time analytics, and visualization to answer critical questions such as: Is the network healthy? Where is a failure occurring? What is its customer impact? And how quickly can we identify and resolve it?
You will collaborate closely with network engineers, scientists, and software engineers to develop novel mechanisms for end-to-end network visibility and diagnostics. Your work will help establish the observability foundations required to operate a highly distributed telecom network where failures can span satellites, beams, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop highly scalable network observability, telemetry, and analytics systems spanning space and terrestrial infrastructure.
- Build real-time and near-real-time pipelines that ingest and correlate high-volume network telemetry, events, traces, and health signals.
- Develop algorithms and services that provide end-to-end network visibility, including failure detection, localization, correlation, and impact analysis.
- Build tools and platforms that enable engineers to quickly understand network health and diagnose complex, multi-hop failures.
- Design distributed systems capable of processing large volumes of telemetry while maintaining high availability, durability, and low latency.
- Develop APIs, services, dashboards, and analytical tools that expose network health and operational insights to internal customers.
- Work closely with network engineers and scientists to translate complex networking problems into robust software solutions.
- Establish metrics, service-level indicators, and automated detection mechanisms for critical Leo network components.
- Design systems that remain resilient in the presence of intermittent connectivity, partial failures, delayed telemetry, and unreliable network paths.
- Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, operational readiness, and on-call support.
- Drive technical decisions across team boundaries and contribute to engineering standards for observability, reliability, and operational excellence.
- Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of high-quality, secure, and maintainable software development.


A day in the life
You will work on problems at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, telemetry, and large-scale analytics. One day you might design a streaming architecture capable of processing telemetry from millions of network components; another day you might develop a mechanism to identify where packet loss occurred across a multi-hop satellite and terrestrial path.
You will work with network engineers and scientists to understand how Leo’s network behaves, develop new ways to make that behavior observable, and turn large volumes of operational data into actionable information. You will also own services in production and work through real operational challenges as the network scales.
This role provides opportunities to work across the stack—from telemetry collection on network infrastructure and embedded systems, through distributed data pipelines and analytics, to the APIs and visualization tools used by engineers operating the Leo network.



About the team
The Leo Network Observability, Visibility & Analytics team is responsible for making a highly distributed global telecom network understandable and operable at scale.
We build the visibility layer that connects network signals across satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial infrastructure. Our systems help transform individual telemetry signals into an end-to-end view of network health, enabling faster detection, diagnosis, and resolution of issues.
The problems we solve are inherently distributed and require us to combine software engineering with networking and data science. We are building new capabilities rather than simply applying existing observability patterns to a conventional cloud service.
If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, designing distributed systems at significant scale, and building software that provides visibility into complex networks, this team offers an opportunity to work on foundational systems for Amazon Leo.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

As this role will influence global team members, you are a highly collaborative player and able to influence without authority while also being able to work with significant autonomy.

To be successful, you must balance being analytical with getting things done, be a team player that is highly customer and improvement focused.

A day in the life
You'll drive technical initiatives across multiple time zones. Your responsibilities span troubleshooting system issues, executing development projects, and solving complex integration challenges. You'll own data pipeline projects, implement ETL workflows, and maintain production systems for procurement operations and GenAI projects. You'll apply CI/CD practices, infrastructure-as-code principles, and data visualization techniques to deliver strategic problem-solving and system optimization across the organization. The team advises on future uses of technology including genAI application in procurement operations and manages the procurement platform for supplier onboarding and RFX. They manages projects to drive process improvements and efficiencies through automation, dashboards, data visualization, and systems integration.
Other global programs include: Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES), Risk & Compliance, Supplier Risk, and Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).

title: Director, Marketing AI Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
About the Role

Audible Marketing is bringing AI-native tools and workflows into its functions, from campaign build and creative production to media planning and measurement. Each new tool empowers marketers to work more effectively. Each one needs a clear business case, a launch plan, and a path to adoption.

The Director, Marketing AI Strategy & Operations, owns the AI tool launches within assigned marketing functions — from initial needs assessment and business cases through GTM strategy, launch execution, adoption measurement, and ongoing optimization. You aggregate inputs from adoption data, user feedback, industry trends, and stakeholder perspectives to continuously refine your approach and influence the product roadmap.

You partner with functional experts to define what the business needs from each new tool. You write the business requirements document with input from functional subject matter experts, size the opportunity, and set the measurement plan. You write the GTM plan for each launch, set its objectives and user-facing messaging, run it through rollout, and measure impact. You map how work will flow once a tool is live and clarify how new tools complement existing team responsibilities. You build and lead the training that helps marketers use new tools with confidence, and you report on adoption so leaders can see what is working.

You own the formal review gates for every launch in your portfolio. You bring the right people to each review and document decisions and open issues. You use sound judgment on whether to resolve a gap within the team or escalate it for a leadership decision.

This role centers on marketing requirements, readiness, and adoption. Martech, Product, and Engineering own technical specifications and build, and you partner with them closely to land each launch and hand it off cleanly into ongoing operations.

Finally, you will help shape this operating model itself, refining how Marketing Strategy & Ops supports Marketing as the AI roadmap grows.

As a Director, Marketing AI Strategy & Operations, you will...

- Own the marketing business requirements for each new AI/ML tool in your assigned functions, partnering with functional SMEs to define the problem, size the opportunity, redesign the workflow and set the “definition of done” for executive sponsor approval

- Conduct needs assessments across your assigned marketing functions, benchmarking current capabilities against industry best practices and identifying where AI tools can deliver the greatest impact for marketers

- Write the GTM plan for each launch-define the positioning and value proposition, translate product capabilities into clear objectives and user benefits, and tailor messaging by audience (marketing leadership, marketers and cross functional partners)

- Map current- and future-state business processes, identifying where workflows, handoffs, and ownership shift

- Identify and eliminate unnecessary process steps, holding partner teams accountable for improvements that accelerate speed to launch and adoption

- Manage GTM rollout and launch execution, working backward from committed dates to confirm that training, communications, support materials, and dependencies are ready

- Design and lead end-user training and enablement, and refresh materials as tools and workflows change

- Lead adoption measurement and reporting, partnering with Finance and Analytics to set baselines, track adoption marketer satisfaction, and business impact- and use sound judgement to make tradeoffs between near-term launch timelines and long-term adoption quality

- Contribute to or own business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and narratives that communicate AI adoption progress, business impact and strategic recommendations to SR Leadership

- Drive alignment and accountability across your assigned functions, MarTech, Product, Engineering-negotiate priorities and resources with partner teams, and influence MarTech and Product roadmaps based on marketing needs and adoption insights

- Proactively identify gaps in process, team readiness, and cross-functional plans; surface risk and blockers early enough for leadership to act, and recommend contingency plans when launches are at risk

- Build scalable mechanisms-Playbooks, templates, review frameworks-that enables Marketing Strategy & Operations to support an expanding AI roadmap

- Champion an AI Adoption culture rooted in enablement and empowerment, ensuring marketers feel supported and confident as new tools are introduced.

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, economics, business or equivalent
- 8+ years in product marketing, product management, strategy or management consulting, change management, business transformation, or marketing operations
- Experience writing business requirements, GTM plans, or launch plans for new products, tools, or processes
- Experience leading adoption of new technology or process change across multiple teams, including training, enablement, and adoption measurement
- Experience mapping business processes and defining operating models, roles, and responsibilities
- Experience defining success metrics and measurement plans, and reporting results to senior leadership
- Experience driving cross-functional accountability across teams you don't directly manage
- Experience producing executive-facing documents and status reporting, with strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading digital transformation or change management programs
- Management consulting experience or an MBA
- Deep experience building AI-native solutions

Your work will contribute to solving some of the most complex technical challenges in the company.

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in fun activities with other interns throughout the summer. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your summer and learn in a real world setting.


Key job responsibilities
- Design, implement, and automate deployment of our distributed system for collecting and processing log events from multiple sources
- Design data schema and operate internal data warehouses and SQL/NoSQL database systems
- Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards to drive key business decisions
- Monitor and troubleshoot operational or data issues in the data pipelines
- Drive architectural plans and implementation for future data storage, reporting, and analytic solutions
- Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Data Scientists, and other internal partners to identify opportunities/problems
- Provide assistance to the team with troubleshooting, researching the root cause, and thoroughly resolving defects in the event of a problem

Our Data Engineers build and maintain the infrastructure to answer questions with data, using software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, and recent advances in distributed systems (e g MapReduce, MPP architectures, NoSQL database. We’re looking for Data Engineer interns to join one of our many lines of business.

- Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
- Hybrid working (team dependent)
- Networking opportunities with fellow interns
- Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
- Mentorship and career development

If you’re successful during your internship, you could be considered for a graduate role after finishing your university studies

Internship start dates vary throughout the year.
Internship ideal length is 6 months.

With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master´s degree program in computer engineering, computer science, or a similar technical field
• Advanced knowledge and/or experience using SQL
• Experience with data querying or modeling with SQL, Excel
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Knowledge of BI analytics/reporting/visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, AWS QuickSight, COGNOS, or other third-party tools)

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s or advance technical degree
- Proficient in at least one or more query language, schema definition language, and scripting language
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience with data visualization software (e.g., AWS QuickSight or Tableau) or open-source project
- Experience with big data processing technology (e.g., Hadoop or ApacheSpark), data warehouse technical architecture, infrastructure components, ETL, and reporting/analytic tools and environments
- Ability to deal with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)
